title: OpenAI Gives ChatGPT Pro and Business Subscribers Up to $500 in Monthly API Credits
summary:
Subscribers to OpenAI's paid chat tiers can now obtain monthly funding to develop their own software and specialized assistants via the company's API. The new benefit allows eligible users to claim credits for the costs associated with building third-party agents and applications.

The credits are distributed based on subscription levels, with Pro plans receiving $100, $200, or $500 per month. Business accounts are allocated $20 for each paid Standard seat and $100 for each Premium seat, with a maximum pooled limit of $500 per workspace.
